answer: A payout is split which means 52% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The nebula schedule is applied in island and violet publishes each instalment. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2545 identities would post 2520 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
